candidates.name: 枝芽 F
candidates.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one polished original logo candidate for "Forami", a web/product analytics application in the "See the Forest" product family. Square presentation on a solid obsidian #0a0d12 background. Restrained warm gold #e0c58c symbol, optionally a very small cool silver #b9c5cf accent. Flat, clean, vector-like graphic with purposeful silhouettes, not a rendered object. Brand mood: calm intelligence, nature, discovering patterns in data, quietly playful, memorable. Large centered symbol above a beautifully spaced, readable bespoke humanist sans-serif wordmark reading exactly "Forami", capital F lowercase orami, warm ivory. No subtitle or other text. Generous margins, symbol occupies about half the canvas width. Make the symbol work as a small software app icon; use few bold shapes, avoid hairline clutter. No gradients, glow, shadows, metallic effects, 3D mockup, photographic texture, charts, stock pine-tree clipart, generic AI network, or Umami bowl. The five concepts are independent, produce ONLY the specified concept in this image. Concept 1 — Branch F. Invent an elegant organic capital F that is also a young branching tree: one subtly curved upright trunk, two confident rightward branches, one small leftward twig balancing the silhouette. A tiny four-point star grows from the tip of the upper branch, one circular seed node on the middle branch. Asymmetric and lively but visually balanced. Make it a distinct crafted logo, with rounded tapered strokes and clear F recognition.
